reviews.comment:
Mi experiencia fue Positiva , me atendieron bastante rapido . Lo unico que me llamo la atencion es que al marcardor marcaba los litros en forma lenta encambio el de la Guita pasaba bastante rapido , mas rapido que decostumbre . No quisiera pensar que esta tocado aproposito el Macador ya que seria una estafa del ACA -YPF de Santa Clara del Mar

(Translated by Google)
My experience was positive; I was served quite quickly. The only thing that caught my attention was that the fuel gauge was registering the liters slowly, while the cash dispenser was moving much faster than usual. I don't want to think that the fuel gauge has been tampered with, as that would be a scam by the ACA-YPF station in Santa Clara del Mar.
